title: Quant profile verification gates and runtime fallback orchestration
creator: Aisha Patel
description: Add an end-to-end verification gate for new quantization profiles (FP8/INT8) that runs during canary rollout and triggers automatic runtime fallback when accuracy regressions or stability issues are detected. This ticket scopes the orchestration changes, calibration harness updates, and observability signals needed to make profile promotions safe and reversible without manual intervention.
background: We have intermittent accuracy regressions when pushing new quantization profiles for medium-length chat workloads. Current canaries surface failures, but remediation is manual and slow. We need a deterministic gate that combines calibration metrics, eval-set accuracy, and runtime anomaly detection to decide pass/fail and automatically route traffic to a non-quantized or safer-quant variant when thresholds are breached.
goals: Implement verification gate that evaluates new quant profiles using calibration run results and canonical eval sets before increasing traffic beyond 5%
Implement runtime monitors (latency p99, token divergence, safety-mismatch rate) that can trigger automatic fallback within 60s of detection
Add orchestration logic to the router to move traffic to a pinned fp32/int16 variant or previous known-good quant profile
Expose gate decision history and rollback triggers in Console for audit and incident review
acceptance_criteria: New quant profile submitted to canary will run calibration and canonical eval automatically and produce a pass/fail decision recorded in Console
If evaluation fails or runtime anomaly thresholds exceed configured limits, router will shift canary traffic to fallback variant without manual intervention
Fallback completes with <2% error in request routing and observed application downtime = 0
Gate decisions and the signals that caused them are queryable in Console with linkable evidence (eval results, calibration logs, histogram diffs)
E2E smoke tests demonstrate automatic fallback within 60s for simulated regression scenarios
design_decisions: Use a two-stage verification: offline calibration + eval pass, then short-duration warmed runtime canary at 3-5% traffic
Treat accuracy delta on canonical eval set as primary signal; treat token-level divergence and model confidence drift as secondary signals
Fallback targets: 1) previously pinned quant profile if available, 2) model variant with higher precision (fp32/int16), 3) global default non-quantized model
Configurable thresholds per-model and per-customer tier; default thresholds will be conservative to minimize false negatives
Implement orchestration as pluggable policy module in router to allow future rollout strategies (linear, exponential, golden)
rollout_plan: Phase 1 (lab): wire calibration harness to new verification API and run 10 historical profiles to validate metrics collection
Phase 2 (canary): deploy verification gate to router; start with internal-only customers at 1% traffic for 48h
Phase 3 (gradual): increase to 5% traffic with automated gate enabled; monitor for 7 days
Phase 4 (promote): on stable results, allow profile promotion to 25% and then full rollout with same gate enforced for future changes
Emergency stop: manual toggle to suspend all auto-fallback if misbehavior observed
calibration_workflow: Run calibration harness producing per-layer scale/zero-point candidates and quant-aware stats (activation distributions, outlier ratios)
Compute calibration quality metrics: per-bucket KL, per-layer MSE, worst-10-layer divergence
Upload calibration artifact to artifact-store with immutable id and link to profile metadata
Trigger canonical eval-run against curated prompt set and record top-line accuracy metrics and failure modes
Aggregate calibration + eval into a single verification score used by gate policy
automation_rules: Gate passes when verification score >= 0.92 OR accuracy delta <= 0.5% relative to baseline
Gate fails when runtime token divergence rate > 2% OR safety-mismatch rate increase > 0.1% over baseline within 1 hour
On gate fail, router executes fallback orchestration with priority: revert-to-previous-profile -> upgrade-precision -> route-to-hosted-failover
Retries: after fallback, system attempts a re-evaluation after 24h with adjusted calibration hyperparams
Alerting: page SRE on P0 failure, create automated incident ticket with decision trace
observability_checks: Calibration artifacts count and freshness metric
Canonical eval accuracy trend and delta vs baseline
Runtime: p50/p95/p99 latency by model variant
Token divergence histogram and rolling window percentiles
Per-customer impact logs for any routed requests during fallback
test_plan: Unit tests for verification score calculator with synthetic calibration/eval inputs
Integration test that simulates a failing calibration file and verifies automated fallback occurs
Load test to ensure router fallback path scales under 1000 rps of canary traffic
Chaos test that injects intermittent inference errors to validate alerting and rollback behavior
Manual runbook walkthrough with SRE and PM to rehearse rollback and audit retrieval
